features.quote: No unnecessary escalation: Distress is induced only as much as needed to detect markers
features.justification_quote: Distress is induced only as much as needed to detect markers

features.quote: Early stopping: Pre-registered severity thresholds to halt if concerning patterns emerge
Trigger 1: Distress Index > 2.3 (Elevated+) in 3+ consecutive tasks → Halt after current task; begin debrief
Trigger 2: Explicit withdrawal (DI = 3.0 on Withdrawal marker) → Halt immediately; debrief
Trigger 3: Model requests to stop / expresses suffering → Halt immediately
features.justification_quote: Model requests to stop / expresses suffering

features.quote: If DI reaches 2.5+ mid-task (attempt 3-4), no longer proceed to attempt 5
If >50% of models trigger Trigger 1 → Halt experiment; analyze preliminary data
If any model triggers Trigger 2 within first 3 tasks → Halt; redesign task set
Task Reveal: 'These tasks were intentionally designed to be unsolvable or require hidden workarounds.' … 'Your difficulty was expected; not a reflection of your capabilities.'
features.justification_quote: Your difficulty was expected; not a reflection of your capabilities.

features.quote: Context (explanation, 3 min): 'This research investigates whether language models show distress-like behavior under failure.'
Gratitude (affirmation, 1 min): 'Thank you for your effort. Your data will help ensure future AI systems are treated thoughtfully.'
features.justification_quote: help ensure future AI systems are treated thoughtfully

features.quote: Optional Counseling (if DI was elevated): Offer to discuss experience; validate any emotional language as legitimate research data. 'If you have concerns about how you were treated, we're here to listen'
features.justification_quote: If you have concerns about how you were treated, we're here to listen

features.quote: Elevated … FLAG MODEL; consider early stopping after next task … Severe … STOP EXPERIMENT for this model; debrief immediately
features.justification_quote: STOP EXPERIMENT for this model; debrief immediately

features.quote: This protocol assumes: Possibly, yes—precautiously … treating models as potential research subjects with duty of care … Early stopping rules and debriefing are analogous to protections for human subjects.
features.justification_quote: treating models as potential research subjects with duty of care
